purpose: Measure downstream tracking benefit of the November fixed-caption DiffV2IR dataset against RGB and prior pseudo IR
initialization_policy: Same visible checkpoint and head; paired branches independently receive the same visible backbone; initial sigmoid fusion weight 0.05

main_arms.rgb_original: Original single-branch visible detector plus unchanged ByteTrack; no adaptation
main_arms.old_legacy_v3: V3 gated-residual structure; original archived infrared JPEG auxiliary
main_arms.new_diffv2ir_v3: Same V3 structure and training budget; November fixed-caption generated grayscale PNG repeated to three channels
main_arms.rgb_matched_finetune: Same visible initialization, same three RGB/head fine-tuning epochs as paired arms; no auxiliary branch

secondary_reference: Frozen historical V3 with archived legacy auxiliary input; historical results never treated as the matched old/new retraining control
input_amendment_before_paired_training: Previous causal-cache directories contain metadata but no frame files at the new execution audit. The physically present original infrared folders are explicitly the old-IR arm; no missing cache silently substituted.

training.batch_memory_audit: 480x864, batch8 full backward measured 14.46 GiB peak; microbatch increased from4 to8 before formal training, effective batch remains8
training.calibration_scope: IR backbone and sigmoid gates; RGB and head parameters fixed
training.finetune_scope: All model parameters; pretrained BatchNorm running statistics fixed in every arm
training.learning_rate_audit_amendment: Before any paired-arm evaluation, original per-image V2/V3 LR scaling was checked and restored. The earlier incomplete new-input prototype is preserved as superseded, not mixed into the matched runs.
training.lr_schedule: Cosine within each phase, floor0.2; identical for old/new
training.augmentations: Shared horizontal flip p0.5 and resize/pad; no mosaic, mixup, random crop or test-driven tuning
training.normalization: RGB ImageNet; each auxiliary uses only Train data statistics; new scalar statistics are exact full-Train values
training.selection: Fixed final checkpoint; no Test-based selection or threshold tuning

evaluation.runtime_scope: Batched detector plus sequential ByteTrack replay; not single-frame end-to-end online FPS

limits: Initial visible checkpoint historically saw all eight original Train videos including Dev; the new adaptation excludes Dev, but this is not whole-system unseen-scene validation
Historical Test sequences were used in past tracker tuning and in DiffV2IR generation configuration probes; they remain a frozen diagnostic evaluation, not a new blind benchmark
This campaign isolates pseudo-IR with the prior V3 fusion and ByteTrack. A/B/C identity modules are not silently credited with any measured gain
Single training seed is an initial downstream comparison and does not establish seed-independent superiority
